args:
echo "[-] [CI Stage: deps] Creating local cache directory structure..."
mkdir -p .cache/isos
mkdir -p .cache/binaries

# Determine source bucket for the blessed ISO
if [ -n "gdc-disk-provisioner-blessed-isos" ]; then
  BLESSED_BUCKET=$(echo "gdc-disk-provisioner-blessed-isos" | sed 's/^gs:\/\///')
else
  BLESSED_BUCKET=$(echo "gdc-disk-provisioner-isos" | sed 's/^gs:\/\///')
fi

echo "[-] Checking GCS for source ISO at gs://${BLESSED_BUCKET}/source/ubuntu-24.04-live-server-amd64.iso..."
if gcloud storage objects describe gs://${BLESSED_BUCKET}/source/ubuntu-24.04-live-server-amd64.iso &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[-] Downloading blessed ISO from GCS bucket..."
  gcloud storage cp gs://${BLESSED_BUCKET}/source/ubuntu-24.04-live-server-amd64.iso .cache/isos/ubuntu-24.04-live-server-amd64.iso
  echo "[-] Download complete."
else
  echo "[!] Error: Source ISO not found at gs://${BLESSED_BUCKET}/source/ubuntu-24.04-live-server-amd64.iso." >&2
  echo "[!] Please upload the blessed ISO to your bucket first to avoid heavy internet downloads." >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "[-] Pulling cached GGD binaries from GCS binaries/ prefix..."
source src/dependencies.env
source src/build/build.env

# Clean the gs:// prefix for local string manipulation if needed
DEP_BUCKET_NAME=$(echo "${DEPENDENCY_CACHE_GCS_BUCKET}" | sed 's/^gs:\/\///')

for file in ${CACHED_BINARY_FILES}; do
  gcs_path="gs://${DEP_BUCKET_NAME}/binaries/$file"
  local_path=".cache/binaries/$file"
  if [ ! -f "$local_path" ]; then
    if gcloud storage objects describe "$gcs_path" &>/dev/null; then
      echo "  [x] Downloading $file from GCS cache..."
      gcloud storage cp "$gcs_path" "$local_path"
    else
      echo "  [!] $file not found in GCS. Fallback to public curl will apply in compile step."
    fi
  fi
done

echo "[-] Pulling cached GGD Debian packages from GCS packages/ prefix..."
mkdir -p .cache/packages
if gcloud storage ls "gs://${DEP_BUCKET_NAME}/packages/*.deb" &>/dev/null; then
  gcloud storage cp "gs://${DEP_BUCKET_NAME}/packages/*.deb" ".cache/packages/"
  echo "  [x] Successfully synchronized cached packages from GCS."
else
  echo "  [!] No cached packages found in gs://${DEP_BUCKET_NAME}/packages/."
fi
steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/gcloud

args:
echo "[-] [CI Stage: compile] Triggering Stage-Gate compilation for version: 0.4.26..."

source src/build/build.env

# Build the targets sequentially using GNU Make dependencies
make -C src/build test-static \
  ISO_VERSION="0.4.26" \
  SOURCE_ISO_FILENAME="ubuntu-24.04-live-server-amd64.iso" \
  GDC_DEBUG_MODE="true" \
  ENABLE_GCS="true" \
  GCS_BUCKET="gs://gdc-disk-provisioner-isos" \
  DEPENDENCY_CACHE_GCS_BUCKET="${DEPENDENCY_CACHE_GCS_BUCKET}" \
  _CUSTOMER_ASSETS_URI="" \
  AUTO_APPROVE="true" \
  INSTALL_COMPANION_URL="https://gdc-companion.ensor-labs.com/v1/install-logs" \
  ADMIN_SSH_PUB_KEYS="ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAII5qAYdMqylY+PYFPdBsp6e9zuVkJnd5eCsRKpYkO+B5 gdc-disk-provisioner" \
  TEMPORARY_INSTALLER_SSH_PUB_KEYS="ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAII5qAYdMqylY+PYFPdBsp6e9zuVkJnd5eCsRKpYkO+B5 gdc-disk-provisioner" \
  TEMPORARY_INSTALLER_PASSWORD="default-password-123" \
  GDC_COMPANION="TRUE" \
  DEBUG_EXTRA_USER="forge" \
  DEBUG_EXTRA_PASSWORD="forge"
steps.name: us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/anthos-bare-metal-lab-1/gdc-build-images/iso-builder:0.0.89

args:
BUILD_META="build-workspace/build_meta.env"
if [ ! -f "${BUILD_META}" ]; then
  echo "[!] Error: Compilation metadata file not found at ${BUILD_META}." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Write git branch and commit to local file for report generator
mkdir -p build-workspace
echo "GIT_BRANCH=feature/update-packages-cache" > build-workspace/git_info.env
echo "GIT_COMMIT=5977364" >> build-workspace/git_info.env

# Import variables from the compilation metadata
source "${BUILD_META}"
echo "[-] Found compiled ISO: ${ISO_OUTPUT_NAME} at ${ISO_OUTPUT_PATH}"

# Trigger deploy, publish, and reports gates via Make
make -C src/build deploy publish reports \
  ISO_VERSION="0.4.26" \
  GDC_DEBUG_MODE="true" \
  GDC_COMPANION="TRUE" \
  ENABLE_GCS="true" \
  GCS_BUCKET="gs://gdc-disk-provisioner-isos" \
  DEPENDENCY_CACHE_GCS_BUCKET="${DEPENDENCY_CACHE_GCS_BUCKET}" \
  _CUSTOMER_ASSETS_URI=""

BUCKET_NAME=$(echo "gdc-disk-provisioner-isos" | sed 's/^gs:\/\///')

echo "[-] Performing bucket retention cleanup (keeping last 5 ISOs in sync/)..."
# List all ISOs in the sync/ directory of the bucket, sorted naturally by semantic version
ISO_LIST=$(gcloud storage ls "gs://${BUCKET_NAME}/sync/*.iso" 2>/dev/null | sort -V || true)

if [ -n "${ISO_LIST}" ]; then
  ISO_COUNT=$(echo "${ISO_LIST}" | wc -l)
  echo "[-] Found ${ISO_COUNT} ISOs in the sync/ folder."
  
  if [ "${ISO_COUNT}" -gt 5 ]; then
    ARCHIVE_COUNT=$((ISO_COUNT - 5))
    echo "[-] Archiving ${ARCHIVE_COUNT} older ISOs to the archived/ folder..."
    ARCHIVE_LIST=$(echo "${ISO_LIST}" | head -n "${ARCHIVE_COUNT}")
    
    while IFS= read -r iso_path; do
      if [ -n "${iso_path}" ]; then
        filename=$(basename "${iso_path}")
        echo "[-] Archiving: ${filename} -> gs://${BUCKET_NAME}/archived/${filename}"
        gcloud storage mv "${iso_path}" "gs://${BUCKET_NAME}/archived/${filename}"
      fi
    done <<< "${ARCHIVE_LIST}"
    echo "[-] Retention cleanup complete."
  else
    echo "[-] ISO count (${ISO_COUNT}) is <= 5. No archiving needed in sync/."
  fi
fi
steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/gcloud
